run: run a process of the dictionary: run "<process>" [record] [Param=value …]
in an ERP kind: run "Set Project Type" 990000 C_ProjectType_ID=103   → erp.process
what it does: Run one process of the ERP's dictionary (AD_Process), as its window button or menu entry does: name = its search key, name or id; record = the record it runs on (an id, or a number/n
ame; kind= when the process is on no single window); then its own parameters as Name=value. Only a process that has a JS port runs; any other is refused naming its class. A wrong process or parameter
name is refused naming the nearest. dry=Y runs it and keeps nothing.
you type: name (The process: its search key, name or id, e.g. "Set Project Type".) · record (The record it runs on: an id, or its number/name.)
taken from where you are: kind
e.g. in Order: erp.process name="Set Project Type" record=990000 kind=Order C_ProjectType_ID=103
